name: Can you replace a standard window with a sliding glass door?

mainEntity.name: Can you replace a standard window with a sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to replace a standard window with a sliding glass door, but it's a more involved process than a simple door-for-door replacement. This type of project requires enlarging the existing opening, which often includes structural modifications to the wall framing, such as installing a new header. It will also involve adjusting exterior siding and interior drywall. A permit will definitely be required for such a significant structural alteration. We can assess your specific situation during a consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but it's more complex, requiring structural modifications, opening enlargement, and a building permit, as it changes the wall's structure.
